originalTitle: Tech selloff weighs down Wall Street as bond yields climb
summary: VIDEO SHOWS: n/a STORY: Wall Street closed lower Tuesday with the Dow falling about a quarter of one percent, the S&P 500 slipping more than two-thirds of a percent, and the Nasdaq sliding one and a third percent. Technology stocks dropped with semiconductors suffering the steepest declines as Middle East uncertainty pushed bond yields to multiyear peaks, feeding concerns about borrowing costs and inflation. Gina Martin Adams, chief market strategist with HB Wealth, says she thinks bonds will remain a driving force for stocks for several months. "I think the biggest threat to the equity market right now is the bond market, not the equity market itself. With yields rising, we have to really consider what we're willing to pay for stocks because of yields, of course, represent the discount rate for those future cash flows that equities tend to trade on. So I do think that the market is going to see its focus shift from earnings as the predominant driver of growth to potentially yields in the fall as we have limited amount of earnings information that is coming out. This could create a rockier path forward for equities, particularly relative to the very robust pace of gains that we've experienced so far this year." Investors flocked to more defensive sectors such as healthcare and consumer staples while the rise in energy prices gave a lift to energy stocks. Individual stocks on the move included Baidu. U.S.-listed shares of the Chinese search company plunged nearly 13% as its revenue missed estimates. And Norwegian Cruise Line declined 3% after broker Mizuho downgraded the stock to neutral from outperform citing construction delays among other reasons.

chineseTitle: 随着债券收益率攀升，科技股抛售令华尔街承压
chineseSummary: 视频显示：无故事：华尔街周二收盘走低，道指下跌约四分之一个百分点，标准普尔 500 指数下跌超过三分之二，纳斯达克指数下跌百分之一又三分之一。由于中东的不确定性将债券收益率推至多年高点，加剧了对借贷成本和通胀的担忧，科技股下跌，其中半导体跌幅最大。 HB Wealth 首席市场策略师吉娜·马丁·亚当斯 (Gina Martin Adams) 表示，她认为债券在未来几个月仍将是股市的推动力。 “我认为目前股市面临的最大威胁是债券市场，而不是股票市场本身。随着收益率上升，我们必须真正考虑我们愿意为股票支付的价格，因为收益率当然代表了股票倾向于交易的未来现金流的贴现率。因此，我确实认为市场的焦点将从盈利作为增长的主要驱动力转移到秋季的潜在收益率，因为我们公布的盈利信息数量有限。这可能会造成股市的未来之路更加坎坷，特别是相对于我们今年迄今为止所经历的强劲上涨步伐而言。”投资者纷纷涌向医疗保健和消费必需品等更具防御性的板块，而能源价格的上涨提振了能源股。上涨的个股包括百度。由于收入低于预期，这家中国搜索公司在美国上市的股价暴跌近 13%。挪威邮轮公司 (Norwegian Cruise Line) 股价下跌 3%，此前经纪人瑞穗 (Mizuho) 以施工延误等原因将该股评级从跑赢大盘下调至中性。
